findings.text: the reconciliation sentence says 176 pending, one reviewed and one exhausted name became accepted beside the whole before-to-after counts, but those counts show pending fell 387 (1108 to 721) and accepted rose 390 (2107 to 2497); 176 is the second pass's pending share alone, so the sentence misattributes the delta a reader is meant to check.

the manifest's status is complete with 391 of 391 restored, while the run's own final message reports blocked with 212 of 391; the evidence logs at 01:17 and 01:41 corroborate the manifest, so the final message is the stale one, but a coordinator reading only the final message would treat a landed node as blocked.

the gate the manifest names collects this file but deselects all three of its tests because each carries @pytest.mark.graph (154, 233, 315), so the recorded 272 passed with 61 deselected exercises none of the new adapter; the review re-ran the file under -m graph and read 3 passed, so the tests work but the node's own recorded gate never showed it.

the script exits 0 unconditionally (as does apply_docs_restore.py:181), so the EXIT=0 in verify-docs-partition.log and docs-restore-gate.log records nothing about whether the measure held; only the printed figures carry it, and a run that read back 300 of 391 would still exit 0.

the instrument joins snapshots over 17:28:00Z-17:29:00Z (census.json instrument.reset_window) while the done_when names the 17:28:08-17:28:35Z reset window; the wider window is disclosed, but the artifact carries no per-snapshot creation time, so the claim that every selected snapshot is the reset's own cannot be checked from what landed.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified the adapter dispatch in apply_signed_manifest and the four production importers of that entry point; none of them selects the new adapter, so the new kind is reachable only by a caller that names docs-revision-restore.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 8466f0e0c6; 1465 insertions in four files: a 586-line docs-revision-restore adapter plus its dispatch branch in signed_manifest.py, a 344-line test file, and the evidence fragment with its instrument; no deletion and no edit to an existing mutation kind.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when is a five-part measure; census.json records attribution left_accepted 405 / reset_names 508, partition a=0 b=9 c=391 with partition_sum 400, drift_dry_run dry_run true detected 84 requires_steering_among_attributed 9, and docs-restore-gate.log records accepted_names_before 2107 and after 2497 with equals_snapshot 391 of 391 and accepted_all_equal true.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to restore the accepted documentation the 2026-11-11 drift refresh reset from its DocsRevision snapshots; docs-restore.json's readback records 391 of 391 partition-(c) names at docs_stage accepted with documentation equal to their own snapshot, and verify-docs-partition.log re-reads partition_c 391 accepted 391 not_accepted 0.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, six commits 8fee17e92..748927474, changed_paths the four landed files, a 31-file tests line recorded at 272 passed on both the head (gate-head-focused.log) and base (gate-base-focused.log) arms, and the whole measure stated quantitatively in its checkpoint.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the run record's write_paths are the fragment, the run.py, a figures directory, imas_codex/standard_names/signed_manifest.py and tests/standard_names/test_signed_docs_restore.py; the diff touches four of those five (no figure was written) and nothing outside them, and the two source paths were explicitly granted in the resumed attempt's advice before attempt 2 began.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_signed_docs_restore.py:161 and :240 fail if the restore stops being admitted on a live-structural-child name or if set_properties starts being admitted there; I re-ran the file with -m graph on a disposable Neo4j and read 3 passed.
justifications.evidence: docs-restore-gate.log and verify-docs-partition.log are receipts carrying the measure's own figures (391 of 391 accepted and equal, counts 2107 to 2497), but both scripts exit 0 unconditionally, so their EXIT=0 is not the evidence and the named pytest gate deselects the three tests that exercise the new adapter.
justifications.fit: signed_manifest.py:6985-6998 declares the adapter constants in the same shape as the thirteen adapters above it, and the module-private _docs_restore_* names describe the mechanism with no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs-restore.json's readback re-reads each of the 391 partition-(c) targets against its own DocsRevision and finds equals_snapshot true for 391, which is the goal's deliverable.
justifications.reuse: the addition extends the adapter family owned by signed_manifest.py; I searched for an existing restore-from-revision owner (DOCS_REVISION_OF across imas_codex/, graph_store/graph_docs_persistence.py's persist_generated_docs, persist_refined_docs and reset_standard_name_docs) and each writes documentation forward only, so no restore owner existed to extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 8466f0e0c6..748927474 touches only the fragment, its run.py, signed_manifest.py and test_signed_docs_restore.py, all inside the five paths the run record declares and the resumed attempt's advice explicitly granted.
